non-production synthetic-scenario reference implementation.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks run.

## Risk and Responsible AI impact

Describe changes to data contracts, model/prompt behavior, evaluation,
security/privacy, cost, or intended use. Write `None` only after review.

## Checklist

- [ ] No real customer/personal data, secrets, tenant details, internal URLs, or confidential content is included.
- [ ] Tests and validation relevant to the change pass.
- [ ] Documentation and the Simulation Card are updated when behavior or limitations change.
- [ ] Outputs remain labeled as synthetic scenarios, not forecasts or probabilities.
- [ ] No consequential financial action or unsupported production claim is introduced.
- [ ] Dependency, infrastructure, and cost effects are documented when applicable.
